summary: Nez Perce National Forest camp dated to about 1930 and listed as abandoned; no source describes what remains at the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as an abandoned camp, not a tower. No source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Camp. firelookout.com gives 1930; the Forest Service list gives 1930 +/-

evidence.supports: section 18 of township 26 North, range 7 East

corrections.why: All four sources describe a camp, not a tower.
The sources say abandoned. None says a structure stood on the site or was destroyed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 1930 and the Forest Service list gives 1930 +/-; the Idaho Fire Lookouts page gives only the 1930s. These agree and differ only in precision.

notes_for_editor: Thin: four short listings and no staffing or fire history. The record location (45.59606, -115.64704, from Idaho Fire Lookouts) is roughly 8 km from firelookout.org's point (45.58980, -115.75530). Not resolved here. The Forest Service list gives T26N, R7E, Sect. 18, which a human could check against the map. Record us-id-concord-2 (firelookout.com point 45.5898, -115.7553) looks like the same camp; merge decision for a human.
